contexts.statement: OpenAI Math Audit #015: Torus-packet equidistribution in prime, quartic, and sextic degrees.
Quartic intrinsic shell estimates for cubic etale Q_p-algebras and self-dual integral quadratic lattices; certify the literal local claim only.

definitions.h: product of maximal-ideal powers giving the exact component denominator shell
definitions.c: min{n>=0:p^n h subset C_L}, the exponent of h/(h intersect C_L)
definitions.K: inverse trace-pairing Fourier transform of 1_shell times gamma, with self-dual measure

claims.natural_statement: Adversarially audit, verify, or refute OpenAI Manuscript Family 015 (Torus-packet equidistribution in prime, quartic, and sextic degrees.; papers: Equidistribution of Prime-Degree Torus Packets with Arbitrary Local Type; Equidistribution of primitive quartic torus packets for arbitrary orders; Equidistribution of Primitive Sextic Torus Packets; Lean status: Partially/Comparator formalized (lean/docs/015.md)): either (a) discover and certify an explicit mathematical flaw, sign/orientation error, counterexample to an intermediate lemma, or statement-fidelity/citation gap with a deterministic symbolic/computational certificate (`verify.py` + `exact_certificate.json`), or (b) independently verify, repair, or generalize the manuscript's core mathematical theorem with a standalone machine-checkable certificate certified by the independent Reviewer.
Prime packets.tex lem:packet-model and prop:unfolding: a full-lattice local homothety type, not merely its multiplier order, has a volume-normalized maximal-order ideal-sum unfolding.
Prime local.tex lem:local-moment: exact shell mass and a positive local norm moment hold uniformly for arbitrary full modules whose maximal-order span is the whole ring.
Prime analytic.tex lem:residue and prop:weighted-count retain the Dedekind-zeta residue in the local-weighted ideal count using exceptional-zero descent and uniform short-interval estimates.
Prime geometry.tex prop:tightness and prop:ball-bound deduce nonescape and O(r^n) local ball bounds from packet unfolding and the residue-normalized count.

Prime paper.tex thm:main: for each fixed prime n>=5, complete packets for arbitrary full-lattice local types converge to Haar when their multiplier-order discriminants tend to infinity. Entropy.tex prop:entropy-from-balls and lem:entropy-components supply positive entropy in almost every component before prime-degree rigidity.

Quartic packets.tex prop:pkt-model and ordinary.tex prop:ord-unfolding, lem:ord-shells, lem:ord-residue, prop:ord-weighted-intervals imply prop:ord-tightness and prop:ord-balls for all orders and their complete invertible-ideal packets.

Quartic exterior.tex lem:ext-products, lem:ext-quadratic-structure, lem:ext-order-scale and lem:ext-density give the cubic-resolvent rank-two action, self-dual integral exterior lattice, its actual stabilizer order, and the product pushforward density.

Quartic local-fourier.tex lem:fourier-shell-estimates: for the literal cubic-etale, rank-two, self-adjoint, self-dual integral quadratic data, shell coefficients decay by p^(3*iota) H^(-1) p^(-j/2), inverse kernels have the asserted norm and support, and at g=0,p>5 each boundary component saves q^(-1/2), uniformly at all depths and ramification types.

Quartic additive.tex lem:add-profile-bounds: local inverse supports and the nonzero global field norm give H << D_F G_0^24 T_boundary and a finite denominator-profile expansion, including arbitrary conductor depth.

Quartic additive.tex prop:additive-equidistribution uses finite shell expansion, lem:add-ideal-lattice, lem:add-nonscalar, scalar trace coefficients and Poisson summation to obtain residue-uniform trace-plane distribution with power saving.

Quartic sieve.tex lem:sieve-residue-function and prop:sieve-averaging combine additive distribution with exterior.tex prop:ext-multiplicity-majorant to prove thm:exterior-count, the uniform area bound on nonzero trace planes.

Quartic rigidity.tex prop:rig-dominated-entropy, thm:rig-ekl-classification, lem:rig-equal-blocks and prop:rig-obstruction reduce proper positive-entropy limits to opposite-pair exterior vectors; conclusion.tex lem:end-unfold and prop:end-tube exclude them using the exterior count.

Quartic introduction.tex thm:main: complete invertible-ideal packets of any orders in primitive totally real quartic fields converge to Haar, without mass escape, as the order discriminants tend to infinity.

Sextic arithmetic.tex prop:packet-volume and lem:ideal-estimate imply prop:cusp, prop:ball and prop:bowen; lem:trace-slice supplies primitive-field separation for two-sided tubes on a growing depth interval.

Sextic conditioning.tex lem:plateau, lem:sampling, lem:patch-comparison and prop:plaque-comparison construct intermediate-resolution conditional probabilities, retain the sampling identity and compare long diagonal motions.
Sextic product.tex thm:product, including lem:u-factor, lem:tiles and lem:stage-information, gives a product rule for the intermediate-resolution limits, not merely for genuine leafwise measures.

Sextic activity.tex prop:activity, lem:va-support and lem:activity-indicators, together with entropy.tex prop:segment-activity, turn the product rule and arithmetic tube bound into crossing-root activity along long segments.
Sextic combination.tex lem:root-line-laws, lem:deterministic-root-arrays, lem:positive-root-intervals and lem:convolution imply thm:full-activity almost surely.

Sextic introduction.tex thm:main and assembly.tex: complete maximal-order ideal packets of primitive totally real sextic fields converge to Haar when field discriminants grow. Homogeneous.tex prop:positive-entropy, thm:ekl and lem:fixed-pieces plus activity.tex lem:transverse-inactive exclude the proper homogeneous components.

Scope limitation: classical quadratic Fourier transformation is not new; ELMV2011 Proposition 9.9 estimates multiplicative local period integrals, not the current inverse-shell kernel. Bounded searches and comparator formalizations cannot prove the unbounded-conductor assertion. No matching sharp exponent result was found by the scoped literature search; this is not a novelty certificate.

Under the exact local hypotheses, prove scalar-shift invariance, the normalized reciprocal Gaussian identity, and the inverse-integral index bound, hence the literal coefficient decay and inverse-kernel sup norm at every prime and every depth.

For c=min{n>=0:p^n h subset C_L}, prove inverse-shell support in p^(-c) h d_E^(-1) for every odd p when c>0; at p=2 prove support in p^(-max(c+3,4)) h d_E^(-1). Deduce the manuscript's p^(-4(g+1)) support at every ramification type without bounding c or g.
When h subset C_L, prove the componentwise one-step boundary support and the 8 vol(R_E) product(q^(-1/2)) estimate for every odd prime, in particular the manuscript's p>5 range.

Construct literal self-dual integral split data over Q_p^3 with stabilizer {(a1,a2,a3):a1-a2 in p^m Z_p}, h=(p^k,p^k,1), and c=g=m-k>=2. Prove an exact nonzero kernel value (1-p^(-1))^2 p^(-c) at (p^(k-c),-p^(k-c),0), proving the improved odd-prime conductor exponent c cannot be reduced.

Give an independent all-depth proof of the literal shell lemma, a strictly stronger intrinsic conductor-support theorem with an unbounded sharpness family, and deterministic exact replay. Local conclusions only: no certification of the downstream global theorems and no campaign completion before independent publication-level review.

claims.natural_statement: Under the exact local hypotheses, scalar-shift invariance, the normalized reciprocal Gaussian identity, and the inverse-integral index bound imply the literal coefficient decay and inverse-kernel sup norm at every prime and every depth.

For c=min{n>=0:p^n h subset C_L}, inverse-shell support lies in p^(-c) h d_E^(-1) for every odd p when c>0; at p=2 it lies in p^(-max(c+3,4)) h d_E^(-1). These imply the manuscript's p^(-4(g+1)) support at every ramification type without bounding c or g.
When h subset C_L, the componentwise one-step boundary support and the 8 vol(R_E) product(q^(-1/2)) estimate hold for every odd prime, in particular the manuscript's p>5 range.

For every prime p, k>=1 and c>=2, literal self-dual integral split data over Q_p^3 with stabilizer {(a1,a2,a3):a1-a2 in p^(k+c) Z_p}, h=(p^k,p^k,1), and g=c have exact nonzero kernel value (1-p^(-1))^2 p^(-c) at (p^(k-c),-p^(k-c),epsilon) for every epsilon in Z_p. The improved odd-prime conductor exponent c cannot be reduced, even on nonvanishing outputs.

For a cubic number field F and nonzero z of bounded norm in the product of the supporting local kernels, H <= 2^12 |Norm z| D_F G_exp^3 T_boundary with G_exp=product p^c <= G_0. The containing fractional ideal has inverse norm <=2^12 D_F G_exp^3. With the manuscript's unchanged boundary convention the constant is 2^12*3^3*5^3, improving its G_0 exponent 24 to 3.

Under the literal local hypotheses the shell lemma holds uniformly at all depths and ramification types; its conductor support strengthens to the sharp odd-prime exponent c and the stated dyadic bound. The cubic denominator-profile exponent improves from 24 to 3, with exact sharpness-family replay. These are local and profile conclusions, not certification of downstream global equidistribution or a substitute for independent publication-level review.
